raster_policy.rule: Every completed trading experiment traverses rasters 1 through 6. A technical fault at any raster returns the same experiment to raster 1 for diagnosis and a safe repair. A valid MISS is not a technical fault: it reaches raster 6, is converted into durable research memory, and the next experiment begins again at raster 1. The cycle continues autonomously until the first technically valid HIT reaches at least 200 from 100 within the blind ten-day window.

ordered_rasters.purpose: Inspect current technical state, checkpoints, data and prior failure. If any later raster broke the system, localize the technical cause, apply only whitelisted repair actions, re-run health checks and restart this same run from raster 1. Never choose or score trading ideas.

Understand what is known before the blind window: read completed-run memory, classify market regime from only the preceding 365 days, identify where previous hypotheses worked or failed and prepare evidence for raster 3. Never inspect current blind-window candles.

Self-improvement and research raster. Explain plausible causes of prior misses, generate a materially different hypothesis, select or expand strategy families, consume vetted external/web-research ideas, vary search design and avoid repetitive loops. It may change the research direction but may not see the current blind ten days.

Verify that the new candidate is buildable, novel, reproducible, permitted by the Germany/Saarland retail research policy and free of look-ahead. Reject duplicate fingerprints, invalid implementations and research plans that leaked the blind window.

Reveal exactly one previously unseen ten-day window and execute the 100-start blind experiment. Record trades, final balance, target-hit time, drawdown, inactivity and technical diagnostics without re-optimizing on those ten days.

Judge the complete experiment. HIT only at >=200. On MISS, preserve regime, strategy family, fingerprint, failure pattern and lesson in research memory, then return the next run to raster 1. On a valid HIT, save proof and stop dispatching new batches.

promotion.rule: A run succeeds only when realized simulated capital reaches at least 200 within its blind ten-day window. A MISS remains valid learning evidence but never counts as success.
